description: Road Safety Audit and A Case Study on Kano-Kaduna Highway in Nigeria is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by ISEC PRESS. As a consequence of increasing traffic volume and mobility, road accidents have been a serious problem especially in low and middle income countries. The number of road accidents in such countries tends to increase every year.Considering different contributing factors to the road accidents, road and its environment have played an important role. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher ISEC PRESS. Its tags are Traffic accident, Accident prone locations, Clear zone, Deficiency. The repository dates the deposit 2017; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
